title: Move the dispatch role's occupancy count from counting panes to the ledger
action: Rewire section 4 of skills/bee-herding/references/role-dispatch.md so its OCCUPANCY COUNT comes from bee herding occupancy instead of from enumerating and classifying herdr panes. This is the move D10 exists for, and the verb it needs now exists (cell ho-10). Edit ONLY the canonical tree under skills/bee-herding/, then run the regen chain inside this cell (bee dev regen: render-skill-trees, then onboard --repo-root . --apply, then release-manifest --write, in that order) so all five mirrors carry it; never hand-edit a mirror. SCOPE THE CHANGE PRECISELY. Section 4 does two jobs today: it counts occupied runtime slots, and it reports anomalies once. Only the COUNT moves. The anomaly scan stays, because an unlabelled pane whose foreground_cwd is a worktree is a fact about panes that no ledger knows — keep that reading exactly as it is. THE FAIL-CLOSED RULE IS THE PART THAT MATTERS MOST. bee herding occupancy reports two shapes: a real crossing of the ledger's unresolved pane ids against the live pane list, and a DEGRADED timer fallback used when the live pane list could not be obtained. The role must read which one it got and must NOT treat them alike. On a real crossing, use the count against the four-slot cap as section 4 always did. On a fallback, the role cannot know occupancy — and note that the fallback fires precisely when herdr could not be reached, which is also when pane counting would have failed, so there is no better answer available. Treat that as a refusal to dispatch this iteration: report one plain line into the chat pane saying occupancy is undetermined and why, and take no dispatch action. That is the same fail-closed posture every other guard in this cockpit takes, and dispatching on an unknown count is exactly the over-spawn the whole ledger exists to prevent. Update section 4's quick-reference row to match, and check whether any other section cites the pane-count as the occupancy source; if one does, point it at the verb too. Do not change section 8's spawn sequence, the lane-safety filter, the interlock, or the merge role.

truths: Section 4 takes its occupied-slot count from bee herding occupancy, not from enumerating panes.
The role distinguishes a real crossing from the degraded fallback and does not treat them alike.
On a fallback answer the role refuses to dispatch that iteration and says so in one plain line.
The anomaly scan over panes is unchanged — the ledger does not know about unlabelled panes.
The quick-reference row for section 4 matches the new body.
Section 8's spawn sequence, the lane-safety filter, the interlock and the merge role are untouched.
